title: The Spark is back

slides.title: The last piece
slides.text: The last piece locks in and the Spark comes back all at once: light, warmth, and every game in Netville humming again. You coded your way here.

slides.title: Bolt says thanks
slides.text: Bolt's antenna is spinning. You took his roads from single steps to loops inside loops, and you never once gave up on a bug. That is what coders do.

slides.title: The whole team
slides.text: Dot solved her last case, Pim delivered every letter, and Gizmo's machines are purring. Four worlds, four pieces, one coder who finished: you.

slides.title: Look what you can do
slides.text: You decompose big problems, debug code that almost works, and choose technology with its costs in mind. Those are the skills every coder builds on.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four big words that are yours now.

words.means: A list of steps, in order, that solves a problem.
To break a big problem into smaller parts you can solve.
A small piece of a message, sent across a network with its address.
To find and fix the mistake in code that almost works.

slides.title: You are a coder now
slides.text: The Spark runs on code, and code is written by people who started exactly where you started. You finished every world. The next step is yours.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Coders do not only play games; they build them. The Builder is ready, with every world in Netville behind you. What will you make first?

talk: Which world taught you the most, and which idea will you use first in your own game?
